# orders-api configuration component (Pulumi, Kubernetes)

Generated by `docuconf pulumi -lang typescript -target kubernetes` from the `orders-api` contract. `OrdersApiConfig` takes one argument per input, checks it against the contract, and renders a Kubernetes container's `env`, volumes and mounts, the ConfigMaps for inline content and overlays, and the pod metadata injected inputs ask for. See [spec/IAC.md](https://github.com/Docuconf/docuconf-go/blob/main/spec/IAC.md).

Values are checked with [`@docuconf/core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@docuconf/core), the engine the app runs at boot, so the messages are the ones the app would print. A value known at preview fails `pulumi preview`; an Output is checked when it resolves, during `pulumi up`, before any resource that uses the outputs changes.

| `LOG_LEVEL` | enum |  | `value`, `configMapKeyRef`, `injected` | Minimum log level emitted |
| `PORT` | int |  | `value`, `configMapKeyRef`, `resourceFieldRef`, `injected` | HTTP listen port |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | duration |  | `value`, `configMapKeyRef`, `injected` | Time limit for handling one request |
| `WEBHOOK_KEYS` | keySet |  | `secretKeyRef`, `injected` | Keys that verify the signature on incoming payment webhooks |
| `WORKER_COUNT` | int |  | `value`, `configMapKeyRef`, `resourceFieldRef`, `injected` | Number of background workers processing orders |
| `discounts` | config file at `/etc/orders/discounts/discounts.yaml` |  | `inline`, `configMap`, `secret`, `csi`, `image`, `injected` | Discount codes accepted at checkout |

## Usage

```ts
import * as k8s from "@pulumi/kubernetes";
import { OrdersApiConfig } from "./orders-api-config";

const config = new OrdersApiConfig("orders-api", {
  DATABASE_URL: { secretKeyRef: { name: "database-url", key: "value" } },
});

for (const cm of config.kubernetesConfigMaps) {
  new k8s.core.v1.ConfigMap(cm.name, { metadata: { name: cm.name, namespace }, data: cm.data, immutable: cm.immutable });
}

new k8s.apps.v1.Deployment("orders-api", {
  metadata: { namespace },
  spec: {
    selector: { matchLabels: { app: "orders-api" } },
    template: {
      // On the pod template, never the Deployment: injectors read the pod's.
      metadata: { labels: { app: "orders-api" }, annotations: config.podAnnotations },
      spec: {
        containers: [{
          name: "orders-api",
          image,
          env: config.kubernetesEnv,
          volumeMounts: config.kubernetesVolumeMounts,
        }],
        volumes: config.kubernetesVolumes,
      },
    },
  },
});
```
